pairs: Igitur post hæc fecit sibi Absalom currus,
Then, after these things, Absalom obtained for himself chariots,
et quinquaginta viros qui præcederent eum.
and fifty men who went before him.
Et mane consurgens Absalom, stabat juxta introitum portæ,
And rising up in the morning, Absalom was standing beside the entrance of the gate.
et omnem virum qui habebat negotium ut veniret ad regis judicium,
And when there was any man who had a dispute that might go before the king’s judgment,
Absalom would call him to him,
Ex una tribu Israël ego sum servus tuus.
“I am your servant, from a certain tribe of Israel.”
Videntur mihi sermones tui boni et justi,
“Your words seem good and just to me.
sed non est qui te audiat constitutus a rege.
But there is no one appointed by the king to hear you.”
Quis me constituat judicem super terram,
“Who may appoint me judge over the land,
ut ad me veniant omnes qui habent negotium,
so that all those who have a dispute might come to me,
Sed et cum accederet ad eum homo ut salutaret illum,
Then too, when a man would draw near to him, so that he might greet him,
and taking hold of him, he would kiss him.
Faciebatque hoc omni Israël venienti ad judicium ut audiretur a rege,
And he was doing this to all those of Israel arriving for judgment to be heard by the king.
And he solicited the hearts of the men of Israel.
Vadam, et reddam vota mea quæ vovi Domino in Hebron.
“I should go and pay my vows, which I have vowed to the Lord at Hebron.
Vovens enim vovit servus tuus cum esset in Gessur Syriæ,
For your servant made a vow, when he was in Geshur of Syria,
Si reduxerit me Dominus in Jerusalem,
If the Lord will lead me back to Jerusalem,
I will sacrifice to the Lord.”
And king David said to him,
Misit autem Absalom exploratores in universas tribus Israël,
Then Absalom sent scouts into all the tribes of Israel,
“As soon as you hear the blare of the trumpet,
Porro cum Absalom ierunt ducenti viri de Jerusalem vocati,
two hundred men from Jerusalem went forth with Absalom,
going in simplicity of heart and being entirely ignorant of the plan.
Accersivit quoque Absalom Achitophel Gilonitem consiliarium David,
Absalom also summoned Ahithophel the Gilonite, a counselor of David,
And when he was immolating victims,
a very strong oath was sworn,
and the people, hurrying together, joined with Absalom.
Then a messenger went to David,
Toto corde universus Israël sequitur Absalom.
“With their whole heart, all of Israel is following Absalom.”
Et ait David servis suis qui erant cum eo in Jerusalem:
And David said to his servants, who were with him in Jerusalem:
neque enim erit nobis effugium a facie Absalom: festinate egredi,
For otherwise there will be no escape for us from the face of Absalom. Hurry to depart,
he may seize us, and force ruin upon us,
et percutiat civitatem in ore gladii.
and strike the city with the edge of the sword.”
And the servants of the king said to him,
Omnia quæcumque præceperit dominus noster rex,
“Everything whatsoever that our lord the king will command,
we your servants shall carry out willingly.”
Egressus est ergo rex et universa domus ejus pedibus suis:
Therefore, the king departed, with his entire household on foot.
et dereliquit rex decem mulieres concubinas ad custodiendam domum.
And the king left behind ten women of the concubines to care for the house.
Egressusque rex et omnis Israël pedibus suis,
And having gone forth on foot,
the king and all of Israel stood at a distance from the house.
et universi servi ejus ambulabant juxta eum,
And all his servants were walking beside him.
And the legions of the Cerethites
sexcenti viri qui secuti eum fuerant de Geth pedites,
six hundred men who had followed him from Gath on foot,
Dixit autem rex ad Ethai Gethæum:
Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite:
et egressus es de loco tuo.
and you departed from your own place.
And today should you be compelled to go away with us?
ego autem vadam quo iturus sum:
For I should go to the place where I am going.
and lead your own brothers back with you.
et Dominus faciet tecum misericordiam et veritatem,
And the Lord will show mercy and truth to you,
because you have shown grace and faith.”
And Ittai responded to the king,
and as my lord the king lives,
in whatever place you will be,
whether in death or in life,
And Ittai the Gittite passed over,
et omnes viri qui cum eo erant,
and all the men who were with him,
and the rest of the multitude.
And they all wept with a great voice,
and all the people passed over.
The king also passed over the torrent Kidron.
et cunctus populus incedebat contra viam quæ respicit ad desertum.
And all the people advanced opposite the way which looks out toward the desert.
Now Zadok the priest also went,
and all the Levites went with him,
carrying the ark of the covenant of God.
And they set down the ark of God.
donec expletus esset omnis populus qui egressus fuerat de civitate.
until all the people who had departed from the city had gone by.
And the king said to Zadok:
“Carry back the ark of God into the city.
si invenero gratiam in oculis Domini,
If I shall find grace in the sight of the Lord,
et ostendet mihi eam, et tabernaculum suum.
And he will show it to me in his tabernacle.
But if he will say to me,
faciat quod bonum est coram se.
Let him do whatever is good in his own sight.”
Et dixit rex ad Sadoc sacerdotem:
And the king said to Zadok the priest:
return into the city in peace.
and Jonathan, the son of Abiathar,
Ecce ego abscondar in campestribus deserti,
Behold, I will hide in the plains of the desert,
donec veniat sermo a vobis indicans mihi.
until word from you may arrive to inform me.”
et Abiathar arcam Dei in Jerusalem,
Zadok and Abiathar carried back the ark of God into Jerusalem,
But David ascended to the Mount of Olives,
advancing with bare feet and with his head covered.
sed et omnis populus qui erat cum eo,
all the people who were with him ascended,
Nuntiatum est autem David quod et Achitophel esset in conjuratione cum Absalom:
Then it was reported to David that Ahithophel also had joined in swearing with Absalom.
to uncover the foolishness of the counsel of Ahithophel.”
Cumque ascenderet David summitatem montis in quo adoraturus erat Dominum,
And when David had ascended to the summit of the mountain,
where he was going to adore the Lord,
behold Hushai the Archite met him,
with his garment torn and his head covered with soil.
you will be a burden to me.
But if you return to the city,
just as I have been the servant of your father,
so too will I be your servant,’
you will destroy the counsel of Ahithophel
Habes autem tecum Sadoc et Abiathar sacerdotes:
And you have with you the priests Zadok and Abiathar.
et omne verbum quodcumque audieris de domo regis,
And any word whatsoever that you will hear from the house of the king,
you shall reveal it to Zadok and Abiathar, the priests.
Sunt autem cum eis duo filii eorum Achimaas filius Sadoc,
Now with them are their two sons Ahimaaz, the son of Zadok,
and Jonathan, the son of Abiathar.
et mittetis per eos ad me omne verbum quod audieritis.
And you shall send to me by them every word that you will have heard.”
Veniente ergo Chusai amico David in civitatem, Absalom quoque ingressus est Jerusalem.
Therefore, Hushai, the friend of David, went into the city. And Absalom also entered into Jerusalem.
